description: This file defines interfaces related to stream namespace predicates used for filtering implicit stream subscriptions within Orleans. It specifies the contract for determining whether a subscription matches a given namespace and for providing predicate instances based on pattern strings.

classes.name: IStreamNamespacePredicate
classes.description: Interface for predicates that determine if a grain should subscribe to a specific stream namespace. It includes methods to check for a match and to retrieve the predicate pattern.

classes.name: IStreamNamespacePredicateProvider
classes.description: Interface for classes that convert predicate pattern strings into predicate instances. Includes a method to try obtaining a predicate based on a pattern.

methods.name: IsMatch
methods.description: Checks if the given stream namespace matches the predicate criteria.

methods.name: PredicatePattern
methods.description: Property that returns the pattern string representing this predicate.

methods.name: TryGetPredicate
methods.description: Attempts to create a predicate instance from the given pattern string, returning true if successful.
